PATTERN: When making quick Instagram Close Friends reels from activity GIFs (games, clips), strip all production elements.
WHEN: User wants a casual reel for close friends, not production content
RULES:
- No title cards, no intro, no outro text
- No custom captions overlaid — GIFs tell their own story
- ~10s per GIF is the sweet spot for game/activity content
- Simple cross-fades between GIFs
- Clean fade-to-black at end
- Total ~30s for 3 GIFs
WHY: Overproducing close friends content feels wrong and the GIFs (e.g. Gartic Phone) already contain full narrative sequences internally
